      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["C000", "F001"],
        "scope_text": "When a storm warning is active and an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration",
        "context_quotes": ["C001", "F000"],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "An agency officer's authorization of an outdoor demonstration during an active storm warning is for the duration of the current warning, expires when that warning ends, and does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "recommendation",
        "scope_quotes": ["F002"],
        "scope_text": "For displays held entirely before sunset",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "should",

        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",

        "statement": "For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": ["F002"],
        "scope_text": "Under the recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for displays held entirely before sunset",
